article.title: Voting through electronic means.
article.content: The Central Government may prescribe the class or classes of companies and manner in which a member may exercise his right to vote by the electronic means.
article.html:
108Voting through electronic means.

Section 108 · Chapter VII · page 76 of the Act

The Central Government may prescribe the class or classes of companies and manner in which a member may exercise his right to vote by the electronic means.
